mapping.description: Each row represents a Chrome visit, with URL, page title, visit time, visit count, referrer, and hidden state where available. Use it to reconstruct navigation and correlate web activity with downloads, authentication, or endpoint events. Browser history can be incomplete because of deletion, private browsing, retention, or profile selection.
mapping.short_description: Shows Chrome URL visits with titles, timestamps, visit counts, referrers, and hidden status.
mapping.query: SELECT urls.url, urls.title, visits.visit_time/1000 - 11644473600000 AS visit_date_ms, urls.visit_count, referer.url AS referer, urls.hidden FROM urls LEFT JOIN visits ON urls.id = visits.url LEFT JOIN visits AS referring_visit ON visits.from_visit = referring_visit.id LEFT JOIN urls AS referer ON referring_visit.url = referer.id ORDER BY urls.url, visits.visit_time

field.description: total number of times the URL was visited
URL of the page that referred to this visit, if available
flag indicating whether the entry is hidden (1) or not (0)
